name: Marching Cubes with Spatial Acceleration Structures
definition: A volume rendering technique that accelerates the Marching Cubes algorithm by using spatial data structures to avoid processing empty voxels, implemented on the GPU using CUDA, where the search for isosurface-containing cells is performed on the CPU.
summary: Marching Cubes with Spatial Acceleration Structures is a hybrid CPU-GPU method that uses spatial data structures to skip empty voxels, distinguishing itself by performing tree traversal on the CPU to avoid GPU recursion overhead.
